summary: Monolithic Power Systems filed a Form 8-K on September 10, 2026, announcing a routine quarterly cash dividend rather than any special situation. The board declared a third-quarter dividend of $2.00 per common share, payable October 15, 2026, to stockholders of record at the close of business on September 30, 2026. No premium, stake, advisor, or transaction mechanics apply; the press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1. This is an ordinary capital-return declaration consistent with prior quarterly payouts, with no deal or event-driven risk-arb angle to monitor.
